values.title: Downspout Surveys in Peel Region
values.mapA11yDesc: This interactive map shows where downspout surveys are upcoming (orange) and completed (blue) in Peel  Region. You can search your address using the tool bar to find out when surveys will happen in your neighbourhood.
values.introductionContent:
Using the map 

You can search the map in three ways:

     1. Select the search bar and type in an address

     2. Choose Use current location in the search bar

     3. Click anywhere on the map to explore a neighbourhood

Your search results will show if downspout surveys are scheduled for your area.

To start a new search, use the tab at the top of the map named Clear search location or the X next to your address search 

Contact us

We encourage you to check back regularly for updates. 

If you have further questions or feedback about the map, please contact Peel Region.

For more information on downspout surveys call Peel Region at 905-791-7800, ext. 4409 or visit Downspout surveys. For more information on downspout disconnection visit Disconnecting a downspout.
